model: per-read (one error class per mate); a per-base variant may be reported as a secondary column but is NOT the primary score

errors.unaligned: reported as its own column, never weighted into the score

break_even: r* = -delta_over / delta_under for a rule-vs-baseline pair (in reads); a rule is net-positive at r iff r > r*
rationale: user anchor 2026-10-21 ('we prefer less data than wrong data') priced at 7:1 and fixed BEFORE the sweep so the margin cannot be tuned to the result; 7 sits just above the measured 6.73 break-even of the 3' terminal-run trade (-35,196 undertrim bought at +236,779 overtrim), which is therefore re-scored at r=7 rather than kept closed by its symmetric-rate verdict
